text: dsh-chat-lanes 在 DSH 网页对话中把用户消息集中到左侧栏，点击任一条目可跳至对应回复；阅读正文或滚动时，侧栏会同步高亮当前轮次。它还提供会话内搜索，用户输入关键词或问题并按回车后，可查看匹配轮次并跳转。侧栏宽度根据面板尺寸调整，消息摘要保持在左侧便于回看。 当前搜索只针对已选中的会话。

dsh-chat-lanes adds a left rail for user messages in the DSH web chat. Click an entry to jump to its reply, with the active turn following scroll position. The rail also searches the current session and links results to matching turns.
我想把自己在长对话里发过的问题固定显示在侧边栏，方便快速回看。
我需要在聊天记录中搜索一个关键词，并跳到匹配的对话轮次。
我想点击某条用户消息后，直接滚动到模型对该消息的回复开头。
把用户与 steering 消息移入固定左栏，按轮次链接到回复，并随正文滚动高亮当前项。
支持当前会话内搜索；输入查询后可通过宿主模型扩展关键词并重排结果，模型不可用时则退回字面检索。
搜索会将查询及匹配片段交给 DSH 配置的 llm 服务处理；具体服务由宿主当前模型选择决定。

把 DSH 对话窗口切成两列：**我说的常驻左栏，模型的话在右侧单轴流动**。

DSH 的对话里，我说话少、模型说得多，我的话被夹在一屏又一屏的工具调用和长回复之间，翻起来很难找。这个插件把「我说的」抽成左侧一条常驻窄栏，正文只留模型与工具的流动 —— 想看我说过什么，扫一眼左边即可。

dsh-chat-lanes README · 它做了什么：- **左栏**：本会话里我说过的每一句，一条一行，带「第 N 轮」；点任意一条 → 右侧滚到该轮回复的开头；右侧滚动时左栏自动点亮当前那条，并把它拉进可视区。
- **隐藏行内的用户消息**（`[data-chat-flow-kind="user"|"steering"]`），正文整体右移让出左栏 —— 我的话只有一个入口，不会两处重复。
- **每轮的行头**：回复起点有一枚绿底小标签，写着「第 N 轮 · 我这句的开头」；点开是**完整原句**（可选中、可复制，右上角有一枚复制图标），点面板外面就收起，同一时刻只开一枚。
- **当前轮按方向判定**，不是一条死的阅读线：往下滚时要等下一条的回复开头越过视口上沿才交棒（上一条整条已离开视口），往上滚时当前这条的开头还在上半屏就不动 —— 避免「还在读这一轮就被换走」和「刚露头就切换过快」。
- **滚动到底**直接点亮最新一条；**切到「插件」「定时任务」这类内置页**时左栏自动收摊。
- 只依赖宿主公开的 DOM 契约（`data-conversation-scroll`、`data-chat-flow-kind`、`data-chat-anchor-key`、`data-chat-turn`、`data-composer-seat`），不碰 React 内部、不接管 `conversation.chat.flow` —— 滚动跟随、折叠动画、锚点恢复仍归宿主。

dsh-chat-lanes README · 会话内搜索（v0.2）：左栏表头常驻一个搜索框，输入关键词或直接问一句话（例：「为什么 max_bid 还会卖出？」），**按回车**后得到按相关度排序的轮次，点一下跳到那一轮的回复。

- 只搜当前会话，我的消息和模型的回复都进候选。
- 走「扩词 → 召回 → 重排」三步，不依赖 embedding；模型不可用时自动退回字面检索（`mode: "lexical"`）。
- 搜索框按会话记忆：切走再切回来，词和结果都还在；换个没搜过的会话就是空的。
- 结果里的轮次如果还没载入（长会话通常只渲染最近几轮），插件会让宿主 `loadThrough` 翻日志再滚过去；翻不到就明说「第 N 轮还没载入」，结果列表保持不动，可以接着点别的。
- 每条结果给一句理由（`why`），方便判断「是词对上了还是意思对上了」。
- 延迟预算约 2.5 秒，所以**只认回车**，不做「停 600ms 自动搜」—— 每敲一个字就起一次模型调用，既慢又贵。

dsh-chat-lanes README · 安装：```bash
plugin_manager install_bundle target=/path/to/dsh-chat-lanes
```

本地开发时 profile 里记的是 `link:` 指向源码目录，改完刷新窗口即可生效。

与 `dsh-user-message-timeline` 的左缘药丸导轨位置重叠，两个别同时开：

```bash
plugin_manager set_plugin target=include:user-message-timeline enabled=false
```

npm install
npm run check      # 语法检查
npm test           # 105 条行为测试（jsdom，约 1 秒）
npm run coverage   # 带 100% 阈值门禁

客户端逻辑（`lib/client.js`）的测试覆盖率必须保持 **行/分支/函数 100%**，规矩写在 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 里 —— 包括这个仓库踩过的每个坑（`CSS.escape` 被遮蔽、MutationObserver 自触发、`assert.equal` 打印 jsdom 节点会挂死进程……）。

index.js            Host 半入口：只调 registerSearch
lib/host.js         Host 半：/api/hellmage/dsh-chat-lanes/search（扩词 → 召回 → 重排）
lib/client.js       Client 半：注入样式 + 左栏 + 搜索框 + 读滚动 + 跳转

dsh-chat-lanes README · 已知限制：- 左栏宽度按面板宽的比例算（18%，夹在 196–288px），还没有配置项；
- 用户消息被整体隐藏，暂无「同时保留行内」的开关；
- 行头的「第 N 轮」依赖宿主的 `data-chat-turn`，没有它会退化成只显示那句我的原话；
- 搜索的重排依赖宿主的 `llm` 服务，模型不可用时结果会退化成字面检索（仍可用，但召回质量下降）。

dsh-chat-lanes README · dsh-chat-lanes：[中文](README.md) | **English**

Splits the DSH conversation window into two columns: **everything I said stays pinned in a left rail, while the model's replies flow in a single column on the right**.

dsh-chat-lanes README · dsh-chat-lanes：In a DSH conversation I speak rarely and the model talks a lot, so my messages end up buried between screen after screen of tool calls and long replies and are hard to find. This plugin pulls "what I said" out into a narrow persistent rail on the left and leaves only the model/tool flow in the main column — one glance left, and you know what you asked.

dsh-chat-lanes README · What it does：- **Left rail**: every message I sent in this conversation, one line each, labelled "turn N"; clicking any of them scrolls the reply side to the start of that turn's answer, and scrolling the reply side highlights the current entry and scrolls it into view inside the rail.
- **Inline user messages are hidden** (`[data-chat-flow-kind="user"|"steering"]`) and the body shifts right to make room for the rail — my messages have exactly one entry point instead of appearing twice.
- **A per-turn header**: each reply starts with a small green label reading "turn N · the beginning of my message"; clicking it opens the **full original message** (selectable and copyable, with a copy icon in the top-right corner). Clicking outside closes it, and only one panel is open at a time.
- **The active turn is chosen by scroll direction**, not by a fixed reading line: scrolling down hands the highlight over only once the next reply's top crosses above the viewport (the previous turn has fully left the viewport); scrolling up keeps the current turn as long as its start is still in the upper half of the screen — avoiding both "switched away while I was still reading"

dsh-chat-lanes README · In-conversation search (v0.2)：The rail header hosts a persistent search box: type keywords or just ask a question in plain language (e.g. "why did it still sell even though max_bid was set?") and **press Enter** to get turns ranked by relevance; click one to jump to that turn's reply.

dsh-chat-lanes README · In-conversation search (v0.2)：- Searches the current conversation only; both my messages and the model's replies are candidates.
- Runs "rewrite → recall → rerank" in three steps with no embeddings; when the model is unavailable it falls back to literal lexical retrieval (`mode: "lexical"`).
- The search box is remembered per session: switch away and back, and the query and results are still there; a session you never searched in stays empty.
- If a result's turn isn't loaded yet (long conversations usually render only the last few turns), the plugin asks the host to `loadThrough` the log and then scrolls there. If that fails it says "turn N is not loaded yet" and leaves the result list untouched so you can keep clicking others.
- Each result carries a one-line `why`, so you can tell whether the words matched or the meaning did.
- The latency budget is about 2.5 s, which is why search **only fires on Enter** — there is deliberately no "search 600 ms after you stop typing", because that would start a model call for every keystroke: slow and expensive.

dsh-chat-lanes README · Install：```bash
plugin_manager install_bundle target=/path/to/dsh-chat-lanes
```

During local development the profile records a `link:` to the source directory; refresh the window to pick up changes.

Its left-edge rail overlaps the pill rail of `dsh-user-message-timeline`, so don't run both:

```bash
plugin_manager set_plugin target=include:user-message-timeline enabled=false
```

dsh-chat-lanes README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm run check      # syntax check
npm test           # 105 behaviour tests (jsdom, ~1 s)
npm run coverage   # gated at 100%

Test coverage for the client logic (`lib/client.js`) must stay at **100% lines / branches / functions**. The rules live in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), including every pit this repo has stepped in (`CSS.escape` being shadowed, MutationObserver self-triggering, `assert.equal` on a jsdom node hanging the process…).

dsh-chat-lanes README · Development：```
index.js            Host entry: just calls registerSearch
lib/host.js         Host half: /api/hellmage/dsh-chat-lanes/search (rewrite → recall → rerank)
lib/client.js       Client half: style injection + rail + search box + scroll reading + jumps
cordis.patch.yml    bundle declaration

dsh-chat-lanes README · Known limitations：- Rail width is a ratio of the panel width (18%, clamped to 196–288 px); there is no setting yet.
- User messages are hidden entirely; there's no "keep them inline as well" toggle yet.
- The "turn N" label depends on the host's `data-chat-turn`; without it the header degrades to just showing my message.
- Reranking depends on the host `llm` service; when the model is unavailable results degrade to lexical retrieval (still usable, but with weaker recall).
